summary: Popup headings in the kit title font
author: pm
body:
The connection and notice popups (overlays drawn with draw_kit_notice_frame / draw_centered_notice_frame, HH-0066 batch 8) still draw their headings, e.g. 'Connection Lost!', in the old bitmap font. Switch them to the kit title font, styled like the other kit dialog titles (HH-0065, HH-0072).

User, 2026-11-25: 'Yes, switch the popup headings to the kit font'.

Waits on HH-0067, which is editing the same files.

**Done when:** every popup heading draws in the kit title font, both builds are clean, and bridge screenshots of at least two popups are attached.

**Closed, 2026-11-25:** review PASS (Sonnet, read-only); Windows and Linux builds clean; screenshots hh0077_log_res_not_existing.jpg and hh0077_query_delete_character.jpg. The other popups were not reached; the longest heading measures about 275 px against the 284 px panel (measured offline).
